store_coordinate_pair_complete.name: store_coordinate_pair_complete
store_coordinate_pair_complete.value:
("store"."latitude_e7" is null and "store"."longitude_e7" is null)
        or ("store"."latitude_e7" is not null and "store"."longitude_e7" is not null)

store_coordinate_seoul_bounds.name: store_coordinate_seoul_bounds
store_coordinate_seoul_bounds.value:
"store"."latitude_e7" is null
        or (
          "store"."latitude_e7" between 374000000 and 377500000
          and "store"."longitude_e7" between 1267000000 and 1273000000
        )

store_published_requirements.name: store_published_requirements
store_published_requirements.value:
"store"."catalog_status" != 'published'
        or (
          "store"."business_status" = 'active'
          and "store"."latitude_e7" is not null
          and "store"."longitude_e7" is not null
        )
